summary: Verified horizontal centering fix on mobile auth screen at both 390x844 and 375x667 viewports. All targeted elements on the LOGIN tab (.auth-logo, .auth-tabs, #loginEmail, #loginPassword, #btnLogin, #btnGoogle, footer/auth-coordinates) and REGISTER tab step 1 (.auth-plans-link, #regFirstname, #regLastname, #regEmail, footer) show identical left/right gaps of 38px (diff = 0.00px on both viewports). auth-card itself is centered with 14px equal side margins. No top editorial image inside auth-card. Tab switching (login->register->login) leaves fields visible with opacity 1 (no blank regression). regPassword not present on step 1 (multi-step register: étape 1 sur 3 = Identité), which is by design — not a misalignment.
critical_code_review_comments: Firestore reports 'unavailable' (offline mode) in console — expected since Firebase demo credentials are not configured in this fork; unrelated to the centering fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vanilla HTML app at /api/app. Landing screen (#kpWelcomeScreen) shown first — click data-testid='welcome-cta-login' to reach auth card. Register form is multi-step (etape 1 sur 3 = Identite: Prenom/Nom/Email only); regPassword appears in a later step. Centering fix on .auth-card via horizontal padding + per-element margin/padding reset is working perfectly (measured diff 0.00px for all inputs, buttons, tabs, logo, footer at both 390x844 and 375x667).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: form inputs on mobile had asymmetric horizontal margins (~60px left vs ~16px right) causing visual right-shift. Fix moved horizontal padding onto .auth-card and reset per-element horizontal margins/paddings to 0 with width:100%/box-sizing:border-box in @media (max-width:980px). Verified: getBoundingClientRect().left === (innerWidth - right) for every measured element on both LOGIN and REGISTER tabs.
